api.docs: https://maritime.sh/docs/computers, read 2026-10-18 for behaviour the schema leaves open

body.command:
'/bin/sh' '-c' 'w="$1"; s="$2"; r="$3"; t="$4"
mkdir -p -m 0700 "$r" "$t" 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p "$s" 2>/dev/null
[ -d "$s" ] && [ -w "$s" ] && [ -d "$r" ] && [ -w "$r" ] && [ -d "$t" ] && [ -w "$t" ] || exit 4
[ -e "$w" ] || ln -s "$s" "$w" 2>/dev/null || sudo -n ln -s "$s" "$w" 2>/dev/null
[ -d "$w" ] && [ -w "$w" ] || exit 5
echo ready' 'melete' '/work' '/data/work' '/data/.melete-run' '/data/.melete-tmp'

: melete-launch act_01J0WORKSPACEWRITE0001; '/bin/sh' '-c' 'b="$1"; c="$2"; i="$3"; e="$4"
cd "$c" 2>/dev/null || exit 112
[ -f "$b.cmd" ] || exit 112
[ "$e" = - ] || [ -f "$e" ] || exit 112
rm -f "$b.rc" "$b.rc.tmp" "$b.log"
setsid sh -c "$7" melete-run "$b" "$e" "$5" "$6" < "$i" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "pid=$!"' 'melete' '/data/.melete-run/act_01J0WORKSPACEWRITE0001' '/work' '/dev/null' '-' '20' '/data/.melete-run/sandbox-env' 'b="$1"
[ -f "$4" ] && . "$4"
[ "$2" = - ] || . "$2"
[ "$2" = - ] || rm -f "$2"
timeout -s KILL "$3" sh -c '\''. "$1"'\'' melete-cmd "$b.cmd" > "$b.log" 2>&1
printf '\''%s'\'' "$?" > "$b.rc.tmp"
mv -f "$b.rc.tmp" "$b.rc"'
